connector.name: Localgym MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for UK gym search using the LocalGym Agent API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package localgym-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lo-nau account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: LOCALGYM_API_BASE
env.description: Optional LocalGym API base URL override; defaults to https://localgym.uk.

env.name: LOCALGYM_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX
env.description: Optional local MCP client-side rate limit per window; defaults to 60. The public API also enforces server-side limits.

env.name: LOCALGYM_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
env.description: Optional local MCP client-side rate limit window in milliseconds; defaults to 60000.
